## Historical Diff Context, Velocity, multiple unrelated fixes and topics, attachements, visibility into other teams' work. You wake up and do a pull. You know the state of changes. When do a pull, we need to add the hash to a SETTINGS table with the timestamp. When we pull, we check if the hash is in the SETTINGS table. If it is, we know we've seen this change before and can skip it. If it's not, we process the change and add the hash to the SETTINGS table. This way, we can avoid processing the same change multiple times and have a record of all changes that have been processed.
